messages:
emily: Postmortem follow-up: model-routing flap caused intermittent p99 spikes and confused failover. Need concrete playbook updates + owners. Short thread pls.

pasha: I'll own the playbook edits for triage steps and add explicit 'traffic-route-check' and 'model-variant-switch' steps. ETA Mon 2024-10-02. Assigning to @pasha.

rachel: I'll write exact debugging commands for oncall and a safe rollback command. Example snippet:```
# check active routing rules
redwoodctl routing list --env prod --format json | jq '.rules[] | {id,name,weight}'
# simulate small traffic to variant-b
redwoodctl test-traffic --route chat-api --variant variant-b --qps 5 --duration 60s
# rollback routing to pinned variant
redwoodctl routing set --route chat-api --variant variant-a --reason "emergency rollback"
```

omar: Suggest adding an automated gate in the playbook: if p99 increases by >30% for 3m after a rollout step -> auto-revert to previous routing and page eng-oncall. I'll implement the gating logic in routing service. Owner: @omar. Due Wed 2024-10-04.

tanya: Noticed recurring pattern: flaps happen during large config PRs to routing weights, often same authoring team. Recommend an approvals checklist + canary windows for routing weight changes >10%. I'll own the checklist and the doc changes. ETA Fri 2024-09-29.

emily: Good. Also need alert rule example for p99 burst + increase in model errors. Can someone drop one?

rachel: Draft alert rule:
```
- alert: ModelRoutingFlapHighP99
  expr: (increase(requests_total{route="chat-api"}[5m]) > 0) and (histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="chat-api"}[5m])) > 1.2 * avg_over_time(histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="chat-api"}[1h]))[1h]))
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "High p99 for chat-api after routing change"
    runbook: "https://docs.redwood.internal/playbooks/model-routing-flap"
```

pasha: For runbook format, I'll include a TL;DR box (one-line runbook), triage checklist, commands, escalation matrix, and a safe-revert command. Also will add a small section: "Who to cc in Slack" with oncall + product").

omar: For the gating implementation, propose rollout steps: 0% -> 5% (10m) -> 25% (20m) -> 100% with validation at each gate (p95/p99 and error-rate). I'll add monitoring hooks to stop rollout on breach.

tanya: Adding policy: any routing weight bump >15% must have a canary plan and runbook PR approval from SRE and Routing team.

emily: Action items (capture here so QA/PM can follow):
- pasha: update playbook (triage steps + escalation matrix)  due 2024-10-02  RW-INC-4601
- rachel: add commands + safe-revert examples + PR for playbook doc  due 2024-09-29  RW-INC-4602
- omar: implement auto-gate + routing service hooks  due 2024-10-04  RW-INC-4603
- tanya: approvals checklist & process change  due 2024-09-29  RW-INC-4604

devops-bot: Reminder: add two approvers (SRE + Routing) to playbook PRs. I will send reminders 72h before due dates.

rachel: I'll also add a short reproducible payload example to the postmortem (message length, metadata flags) so ML/product can triage triggers.

pasha: For the escalation matrix: if page during US business hours -> page eng-oncall and CC routing lead. Outside hours -> page oncall + auto-cut to fallback variant. I'll add this as a flowchart.

emily: Let's schedule a quick sync (15m) tomorrow to confirm owners and gating details. I'll post an invite.

tanya: Also suggest adding a 90-day recurring check: monthly for first 90 days after fixes to monitor for regressions. I'll create calendar series.

omar: I'll add dashboards: a 'routing-flap' dashboard with p50/p95/p99, error-rate, and per-variant QPS. Owning dashboard PR.

emily: Nice. Closing the loop: I'll update the postmortem doc with these owners + links to Jira when they exist. Please comment here with Jira IDs.

rachel: PR draft: https://git.internal.redwood.com/r/playbooks/pulls/201 (draft)

pasha: I'll review the PR and add the TL;DR and escalation matrix.

devops-bot: Thread will be archived after 72h of inactivity. Reminders queued.

emily: Thanks everyone. If anything changes, post here or update the tickets.
